§ 2why existing apps fail

Most apps assume motivation.
CivicCircles is designed for the moments when it's gone.

what existing apps ask of you
scroll a feed browse profiles swipe humans message strangers show up alone post a witty photo install an app create an account build a profile verify an email
what CivicCircles asks of you
open one email tap one button

“The people who need connection most are the least likely to initiate it.”

the design constraint

CivicCircles · pitch§ 4 · the solution
05 / 12
§ 4the solution

Referral in.   Invitation out.   Real-world circle formed.

01 / referrer
Trusted referrer creates profile
GP, POH-GGZ, counselor or social worker — with explicit consent.
→
02 / engine
AI forms a small circle
Matched on city, comfort, availability, accessibility.
→
03 / operator
City operator approves
A human always signs off. AI never publishes alone.
→
04 / resident
Email invitation arrives
Three buttons. No app. No password. No profile.
→
05 / arrival
Check-in unlocks Circle Reveal
Identities appear only on arrival — never before.

Nothing in this chain requires the resident to search, message, or initiate — that is the entire design.

CivicCircles · pitch§ 7 · operational layer
08 / 12
§ 7matching + operational layer

Not an app. A three-layer civic operating system.

01
Trusted referrals — top
GPs, POH-GGZ, psychologists, counselors, social workers create lightweight profiles with consent.
BIG / AGB verified consent-recorded no clinical data
02
Matching + safety engine — middle
Forms small compatible circles. Hard constraints first, then soft ranking, then group formation.
preferences city filtering group compatibility activity fit audit log
03
City & operator network — base
Approved venues, hosts and activities. Every proposed circle reviewed by a human operator before invitations go out.
venue approval host network supply curation operator override

The resident sees only the surface — one invitation. Three layers operate underneath.

CivicCircles · pitch§ 10 · differentiation
11 / 12
§ 10why it wins

We don't compete for attention.
We reduce friction to attendance.

Consumer social apps

  • browse a feed
  • swipe profiles
  • message strangers
  • initiate the contact
  • public profiles
  • algorithmic engagement

CivicCircles

  • trusted referral in
  • curated invitation out
  • no signup, no app
  • human approval before send
  • offline check-in unlocks identity
  • civic infrastructure, not engagement

§ A.3matching strategy

Constraints first. Ranking second. Humans last.

stage 01
Hard constraints
city, accessibility, avoid list, availability, safety — non-negotiable.
city a11y avoid list when safety
stage 02
Soft ranking
interests, activity type, group comfort, distance, prior feedback.
interests type comfort distance feedback
stage 03
Group formation
small circles of compatible people with similar comfort levels.
size 3 – 5 comfort fit host present
stage 04
Operator approval
a city operator reviews, edits or rejects. AI never publishes alone.
review approve override

Send referral

The Dutch GP consult is ten minutes. CivicCircles fits inside it — never after-hours admin.

CivicCircles · briefing§ A.9 · stack
22 / 22
§ A.9implementation stack

Boring choices on purpose — shippable, auditable, cheap.

frontend
Next.js
Resident map · invitation surfaces · referrer dashboard · operator console.
backend
FastAPI
Profile, preferences, consent, audit endpoints — typed and inspectable.
storage
SQLite → Postgres
SQLite in prototype. Postgres + row-level security in pilot.
activity catalog
Curated index
Per-municipality, per-neighbourhood. Approved venues + hosts only.
matching · ranking
Service
Constraints → score → group. Every decision logged for the audit.
operator APIs
Approval + venues
Approve · edit · reject · curate. Same surface a welzijnscoach uses.

Plus: NEN 7510 / ISO 27001 controls · ZorgMail Edifact ingress for pilot · BIG & AGB verification cached nightly.
